items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: We had special writers, Harold Arlen, Jimmy McHugh and Dorothy Fields. They were writers, they were on the staff

ctx.x: Productions, because the producer, he had a guy called Clarence Robinson, was assistant to Leonard and every year he would go to Europe and see the different shows, they would come back and give ideas to our show. We had special writers, Harold Arlen, Jimmy McHugh and Dorothy Fields. They were writers, they were on the staff, that's right. It was production, man, just like Ziegfeld put on a production. That's what we put on there. We had that.
Do you think the Cotton Club shows were better than the Ziegfeld shows.
